name: Slides Into Russian
effect: Boosting this layer-10 neuron makes the model answer in Russian, often switching from English partway through the first sentence. “Here are три совета дляการสัมภาษณ์งาน:”
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
